subject: FY22 Budget Hearing Schedule
overview: The Personnel & Budget Subcommittee reviewed the administration's proposed framework and timeline for the fiscal year 2022 school budget process. The subcommittee voted to forward the schedule of six public budget hearings to the full School Committee.

items.title: FY22 Budget Timeline and Strategy
items.summary: District leadership presented a schedule of six public budget hearings spanning April 27 through May 12 and addressed federal pandemic relief funds, after-school program challenges, and meeting document distribution timelines before the subcommittee voted to forward the hearing dates to the full School Committee.
